mentions.name: ThreatCluster
mentions.description: Aggregates cybersecurity news from over 100 sources and automatically clusters related reports, so readers see complete threat stories with timelines and analysis instead of scattered fragments.
mentions.problem: Cybersecurity news is scattered across many sources, leaving readers with fragmented coverage instead of complete threat stories.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on ThreatCluster - automatically clusters related cybersecurity news from over 100 sources, so you see complete threat stories, timeline and analysis instead of scattered fragments.
